We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing analytics team. You'll partner with finance and operations to turn data into decisions.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau
- Write SQL to pull and clean data from our warehouse
- Present findings to stakeholders

What you'll bring
- 2+ years of experience in data analysis
- Strong SQL skills
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field

Nice to have
- Python
- Experience in healthcare
